title: Prime Minister Internship Scheme
description: Government of India initiative offering internship opportunities to youth. Check the official portal for current listings and eligibility.

title: Google Summer of Code Contributor Program
description: Global online contributor program where eligible students and open-source beginners work on mentored coding projects. It is not employment or an internship.

title: URSC Student Internship
description: URSC offers student internships and academic project work in connection with students' curricula. The page reports limited yearly slots and no stipend.

title: URSC Academic Project Work
description: URSC provides academic project-work opportunities subject to project, facility and course suitability. The page reports no stipend.

title: SAC Student Internship
description: SAC offers internship opportunities for students in science and engineering disciplines relevant to its programmes. The official page lists academic prerequisites and no stipend information was assumed.

title: MCF Student Internship
description: MCF offers student internships based on project, facility and course suitability. Its page says the 2024 cycle was closed and provides no current deadline.

title: MCF Student Project Trainee Scheme
description: MCF provides academic project work for UG, PG and PhD students subject to facility and project availability. The page says the 2024 internship cycle was closed.

title: VSSC Student Internship and Academic Project Work
description: VSSC offers limited internship and final-year academic project opportunities in science and technology disciplines relevant to its programmes.

title: IIRS External Student Internship
description: ISRO lists IIRS's external student internship page among its centre and unit student opportunities. Check the linked IIRS page for current details.

title: LPSC Student Internship
description: LPSC accepts internship applications from eligible engineering students in relevant disciplines. Its page states a 21-to-45-day period and no stipend.

title: LPSC Academic Project Work
description: LPSC offers student project work in relevant engineering branches. Its page describes degree-specific prerequisites and says no stipend is provided.

title: NRSC Student Internship
description: NRSC offers internships to eligible UG, PG and PhD students, subject to guide availability and limited seats. The page states an internship period of around 45 days.

title: NRSC Student Project Work
description: NRSC lists academic student projects with degree-specific prerequisites and project periods. Check the official page for application details.

title: NARL Student Projects
description: ISRO lists NARL's student-project information under its centre and unit student-opportunity links. Check NARL's official site for current details.

title: PRL Summer Internship Programme
description: PRL's summer internship gives selected graduate and postgraduate students and college teachers project exposure with institute scientists. The 2026 cycle ran May 11 to July 10; no future deadline is listed here.

title: SDSC SHAR Internship and Project Training
description: SDSC SHAR describes internship and project-training applications for students pursuing graduation, post-graduation or research in science and technology.

title: ISTRAC Student Internship
companyName: ISRO Telemetry, Tracking and Command Network
description: ISRO lists ISTRAC's student-internship page among its centre and unit student opportunities. Check the linked page for current application details.

title: CAG Student Internship Programme
companyName: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
description: The official CAG site lists a Student Internship Programme. Details could not be independently retrieved; check the official page.

title: NHRC Internship Programme
companyName: National Human Rights Commission of India
description: The official NHRC site lists internship programmes. Details could not be independently retrieved; check the official page.

title: NICSI Internship Scheme
description: An official NICSI search result identifies an Internship Scheme notification. The PDF could not be retrieved; check NICSI for current details.
